Test Report Management

Test report management for every type of power equipment

One web platform that records every test, calculates results against tolerance and generates branded, print-ready reports for transformers, power cables, capacitors, motors and generators.

  • Work orders, clients and reusable equipment templates
  • Automatic calculations with PASS / FAIL against tolerance
  • Branded multi-page reports with signature blocks
  • Role-based access with a full audit trail
Request a Demo

Equipment and test modules

Power & Distribution Transformers

15 routine and type test modules: voltage ratio, vector group, winding resistance, losses, partial discharge, temperature rise, impulse and more.

HVAC Power Cables (MV / HV / EHV)

Conductor resistance, partial discharge, AC voltage, tan delta, capacitance and insulation checks for routine, sample and type test reports.

Submarine HVAC Cables

Routine and type test records for AC submarine cables, including armour, sheath and length-wise test data.

HVDC Power Cables

DC withstand, polarity reversal, impulse and load-cycle records with automatic pass / fail checks.

Capacitors

Capacitance, tan delta, insulation resistance, voltage withstand and discharge tests with unit-wise results.

Motors

Winding resistance, insulation resistance and PI, no-load, blocked-rotor and temperature-rise records.

Generators

Insulation and winding resistance, open- and short-circuit characteristics, temperature rise and protection checks.

Switchgear, CT / PT, Reactors & More

Template-based custom modules built to your test procedures and report formats.

Transformer modules are ready to use. Cable, capacitor, motor, generator and other equipment modules are configured to your test procedures and report formats.

What We Do

Our Services

From routine maintenance to advanced laboratory development — we cover the full spectrum of electrical engineering needs for industries, utilities and commercial facilities.

Breakdown & Preventive Maintenance

Industrial breakdown response and scheduled preventive maintenance for compressors, overhead cranes, heaters, transformers, air conditioners, and AHU units — for industrial and commercial premises.

Environmental Monitoring Services

Comprehensive site monitoring including sound levels, lux measurement, earth resistance testing, and air pollution measurement to ensure regulatory compliance and workplace safety.

Calibration Services

Precision calibration for electrical instruments and measurement equipment, ensuring accuracy and traceability to national and international standards.

Lab Development & Setup

End-to-end development of Electrical Test Labs, PD (Partial Discharge) Labs, Soundproof Rooms & Labs, and upgradation of transformer test laboratories — including brand new lab setups.

Test Report Automation & Web Development

Custom web app development for test report automation and professional website development tailored for engineering organisations and institutions.

Electrical Inspections & Third-Party Support

Independent electrical inspections and inspection support services, deploying qualified engineers as certified third-party inspectors for industries and organisations.

Electrical Safety Audits

Thorough electrical safety audits for manufacturing plants and commercial facilities, identifying risks and ensuring compliance with safety codes and standards.

ISO & NABL Audit Support

External ISO audits, NABL IEC/ISO 17025 preparation and support, supplier auditor services, and vendor audits to help organisations achieve and maintain accreditation.

Annual Maintenance Contracts

Planned yearly maintenance contracts for motors, compressors, cranes, transformers and HVAC equipment, with scheduled visits and priority breakdown support.

Power & Distribution

Transformers & Substations

Supply, testing and lifecycle support for transformers and substation projects, backed by our own test and report automation.

Power Transformers

Oil-immersed power transformers for utility substations and large industrial plants.

  • Supply, installation & commissioning
  • Routine and type testing support
  • Factory-to-site project coordination

Distribution Oil-Type Transformers

Rugged outdoor distribution transformers for networks, industries and commercial campuses.

  • Pole, plinth and kiosk mounting
  • Oil sampling & DGA support
  • Retrofit, repair and refurbishment

Dry-Type / Cast Resin Transformers

Fire-safe, low-maintenance transformers for buildings, data centres and indoor substations.

  • Suited to indoor and high-occupancy sites
  • Low maintenance, no oil handling
  • Protection and temperature monitoring

Special Type Transformers

Application-specific designs: furnace, rectifier, traction, earthing and custom ratings.

  • Built to your specification
  • Harmonic and duty-cycle review
  • Design consultation and testing

Substation Turnkey Solutions

Complete substation projects from design and civil to energisation and handover.

  • Engineering, supply and erection
  • Testing and commissioning
  • Documentation and statutory support

Transformer Service & Testing

Life-extension, repair and condition assessment for transformers in service.

  • Routine and diagnostic testing
  • Oil filtration and treatment
  • Breakdown response and spares

Cable Accessories

Cable Terminations, Joints & Connectors

Heat-shrink, cold-applied and separable accessories for LV, MV and HV power cables.

Separable Connectors

Screened, touch-proof T-type connectors for switchgear and transformer cable entries.

  • 11 kV, 15 kV and 33 kV classes
  • Fully screened and shielded
  • Safe to touch when energised

Cable Jointing Kits (3-Core)

Heat-shrink termination kits for 3-core XLPE and PILC cables.

  • 1.1 kV, 3.3 kV and 11 kV kits
  • Indoor and outdoor use
  • Complete with lugs and stress control

Heat-Shrinkable Sleeves

Polyolefin sleeves for insulating conductors, lugs and joints.

  • 1.1 kV, 6.6 kV and 11 kV
  • Flame retardant polyolefin
  • Wide range of diameters

Silicone Right-Angle Boots

Flexible boots insulating right-angle cable terminations on transformers and switchgear.

  • 120, 150 and 400 sq mm
  • Silicone, track resistant
  • Removable for testing

Heat-Shrinkable Cable Joints

Straight-through joints restoring insulation and screening on MV cables.

  • 11 kV class
  • 3-core and single-core options
  • Moisture-sealed finish

Busbar Sleeves

Heat-shrink busbar insulation that prevents flash-over in tight panels.

  • 6.6 kV polyolefin
  • Rolls and cut lengths
  • Red, easy to inspect

Outdoor Termination Kits

Weather-resistant three-phase terminations with creepage sheds.

  • 11 kV class
  • Tracking-resistant sheds
  • Suits overhead-to-cable transitions

HV Composite Termination

Composite-insulated high-voltage termination for outdoor and equipment connections.

  • Silicone housing, sealed end
  • Flange-mounted base
  • Specify rating on enquiry
